dialogue: [color=#cd2d06]Violet Tip #3:[/color] Here's another trick about slide boosting:
after you [color=#f8c868]slide boost[/color], you can carry the momentum a little further by [color=#f8c868]sliding again[/color] as you land!
This might not seem like much, but here’s the cool part: [color=#f8c868]you can then jump and slide boost again![/color]
SO! Want to fly through the bushes? [color=#f8c868]Slide boost[/color], then [color=#f8c868]boost again[/color].
Chain them together and, yeah, you get the idea!
Once you get it down, it’s the only way you'll want to move around!
Of course, until you slam headfirst into a wall you thought you could clear...
Sometimes, I've found nooks and crannies I’d only reach by chaining a couple [color=#f8c868]slide boosts[/color]!
If you’re having trouble with the rhythm, try practicing with [color=#f8c868]these two gaps[/color] right next to this sign!
They’re spaced perfectly to [color=#f8c868]slide boost twice in a row[/color]!
